sections.title: Who we are
body: Best View Glazing Ltd ("we", "us") provides window and door repair services across Greater London. This policy explains how we handle personal information collected through this website.

sections.title: What we collect
body: When you submit the enquiry form we collect the details you enter: your name, email address, postcode, property type, the service you need, a description of the problem, your preferred contact time and, if you choose to provide them, your phone number, property address and photographs of the window or door.
We also record the date and time of the enquiry, the page it was sent from and basic technical information such as the browser type, which helps us prevent misuse of the form.

sections.title: Why we collect it and our lawful basis
body: We use this information to assess your enquiry, prepare and send a quotation, and arrange and carry out any repair you agree to. Our lawful basis is that the processing is necessary to take steps at your request before entering into a contract, and to perform that contract once work is agreed.
We do not use your details for marketing and we do not sell or rent personal information to anyone.

sections.title: Who we share it with
body: Your enquiry is delivered to us by the email or form-processing provider connected to this website, which processes it on our behalf under contract. Where a repair requires parts from a supplier we share only the technical details needed to source them, never your contact information.
We may disclose information where the law requires it.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Enquiries that do not lead to work are kept for up to 12 months so that we can respond to follow-up questions, then deleted. Records relating to work we have carried out are kept for the period required for accounting and warranty purposes, after which they are deleted or anonymised.

sections.title: Photographs you upload
body: Images are used solely to understand the fault and prepare your quotation. Please avoid including people, documents or anything unrelated to the window or door in your photographs.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
body: This website does not set advertising or tracking cookies. If analytics or similar tools are introduced in future, this policy will be updated and any consent required will be requested before they are used.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You have the right to access the personal information we hold about you, to have it corrected or deleted, to restrict or object to its processing, and to data portability where applicable. You also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk).
To exercise any of these rights, send a request through the website enquiry form and we will respond within one month.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy from time to time. The date of the latest revision is shown at the top of the page.

sections.title: Use of this website
body: This website is provided by Best View Glazing Ltd for information about our window and door repair services and to allow you to request a quotation. By using the site you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.
You must not use the enquiry form to send unlawful, offensive or misleading content, or to attempt to interfere with the operation of the site.

sections.title: Enquiries and quotations
body: Submitting an enquiry does not create a contract. We review each enquiry and, where we are able to help, respond with repair information and a quotation. A quotation is based on the information you provide and may be revised if the fault, the parts required or the access arrangements turn out to be different from what was described.
Quotations are valid for the period stated on them. A contract for repair work is formed only when you accept a quotation and we confirm the arrangement in writing.

sections.title: Carrying out the work
body: We will carry out agreed work with reasonable skill and care using appropriate parts and materials. Where a part is obsolete we will fit a suitable compatible equivalent and tell you so. Some repairs require a return visit once parts have been manufactured or sourced.

You are responsible for providing safe access to the window or door and for telling us about anything at the property that could affect the work, such as asbestos, fragile surfaces or restrictions on working hours.

sections.title: Service area
body: Our services are provided within Greater London only. We may decline enquiries for properties outside that area.

sections.title: Accuracy of information
body: We take care to keep the information on this site accurate and up to date, but it is general in nature and is not a substitute for an assessment of your particular window or door. Descriptions of repairs are illustrative and the appropriate repair for your property will be set out in your quotation.

sections.title: Liability
body: Nothing in these terms limits or excludes our liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, for fraud, or for anything else that cannot be limited or excluded by law. Subject to that, we are not liable for any loss that was not a foreseeable result of our breaking these terms, or for business losses where you use our services as a consumer.

sections.title: Intellectual property
body: The content, design and branding of this website belong to Best View Glazing Ltd or its licensors and may not be copied or reused without permission.

sections.title: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales and any dispute will be dealt with by the courts of England and Wales.
